propositions: Live declared-none children are neutral in scope inheritance: they contribute no paths and do not poison sibling path declarations.
Any live undeclared child poisons child inheritance, blocking inherited paths and preventing all-none promotion of the parent.
All-none scope is authentic only when at least one live child exists and every live child is authenticated none; no live children does not synthesize none.
Parent-owned paths take precedence over all-none children; a parent declared paths is never promoted to none regardless of child scope.

Scope precedence rule: any own, cited, or inherited dependency path yields paths; otherwise explicit parent none yields none; otherwise all-live-children-none promotes only an undeclared parent to none; otherwise unscoped.

P9 must pass leaves and containers whose live children are all declared, ignore closed children, count only live undeclared children as poisoners, and advise both path declaration and --none as truthful remedies.
